reason: The first runner implementation hashed the multi-GiB GGUF with read_bytes, temporarily duplicating the model in Python memory. Host available RAM dipped below the 4 GiB floor and swap rose. The runner was interrupted during the first HTTP completion request; no raw output was recorded, and the call is excluded from all scored denominators.
resolution: Changed the SHA-256 check to stream 1 MiB chunks; confirmed the llama slot idle and host available memory recovered to about 8.1 GiB before restarting the complete H-A2 series.
